## History

Roger Pye is a member of the Pye family residing in the village. Following a mix-up with paint numbers, his relative [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) paints the local hall a glaring bright blue with a red roof. This hideous outcome initially shocks the village, ultimately shifting public sympathy against the [Pyes](../codex/factions.md#pyes) and in favor of the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society).

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P2](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0002), [v2 IX A Question of Color P3](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0003), [v2 IX A Question of Color P4](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0004), [v2 IX A Question of Color P5](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0005), [v2 IX A Question of Color P6](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0006), +23 more_

## Relationships

### [John Andrew](../character/john-andrew.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/john-andrew--roger-pye.md)

Roger Pye is the parent of [John Andrew](../character/john-andrew.md). Their familial connection ties Roger to the broader Pye family within the village, whose members become a focal point of public scrutiny following Joshua Pye's botched painting of the local hall.
